name: Commission_Calculator
summary: Commission Calculator is a utility EA that calculates and displays trading commission costs for various order types and volumes. It helps traders estimate transaction costs before placing trades by computing commission amounts based on broker-specified rates. The EA does not open any positions and serves purely as a cost-analysis tool.
summary_zh: 佣金计算器是一个工具类EA，用于计算和显示不同订单类型和交易量的交易佣金成本。它帮助交易者在下单前根据券商指定的费率估算交易成本，不进行任何开仓操作，纯粹作为成本分析工具使用。
strategy_analysis: 该EA是一个纯工具型程序，不包含任何交易策略逻辑。它的核心功能是根据用户设定的佣金费率、交易手数和订单类型来计算预期佣金费用。入场条件和出场条件均不适用，因为该EA不会执行任何交易操作。仓位管理方面没有涉及，因为不存在开仓行为。资金管理方面，该工具仅提供成本估算辅助，帮助交易者在进行资金管理决策时考虑佣金因素。整体而言，这是一个辅助决策工具，其价值在于提升交易者对交易成本的认知和透明度。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a pure utility program that contains no trading strategy logic whatsoever. Its core function is to calculate expected commission fees based on user-configured commission rates, trade lot sizes, and order types. Entry and exit conditions are not applicable since the EA does not execute any trades. Position sizing is not involved as no positions are ever opened. In terms of money management, the tool only provides cost estimation assistance to help traders factor commission costs into their money management decisions. Overall, this is a decision-support utility whose value lies in improving traders' awareness and transparency regarding trading costs.

parameters.name: OrderType
parameters.description: 订单类型(0=市价买,1=市价卖)

parameters.name: VolumeMultiplier
parameters.description: 手数倍率用于批量计算

pros: 提供交易前佣金成本估算，增强交易成本透明度
界面简洁直观，操作方便易于使用
帮助新手交易者理解佣金对盈利的影响
pros_en: Provides pre-trade commission cost estimation, enhancing trading cost transparency
Simple and intuitive interface, easy to operate and use
Helps novice traders understand the impact of commissions on profitability
cons: 功能单一，仅计算佣金不含点差和隔夜费
缺乏与实际账户佣金结构的自动同步功能
无法根据历史交易数据汇总累计佣金成本
cons_en: Single function, only calculates commissions excluding spread and swap fees
Lacks automatic synchronization with actual account commission structure
Cannot aggregate cumulative commission costs based on historical trade data
improvements: 增加点差和隔夜费的综合成本计算功能
添加与账户佣金结构自动同步的接口
支持历史交易佣金汇总统计和报表导出
improvements_en: Add comprehensive cost calculation including spread and overnight swap fees
Add interface for automatic synchronization with account commission structure
Support historical trade commission aggregation statistics and report export

risk_points: 无交易风险，但佣金估算不准确可能导致资金管理误判
依赖手动输入佣金费率，若输入错误将导致成本估算偏差
risk_points_en: No trading risk, but inaccurate commission estimation may lead to money management misjudgment
Relies on manual input of commission rates; incorrect input will cause cost estimation deviation
